about: Sechelt is a district municipality on British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast, on the isthmus between Sechelt Inlet and the Strait of Georgia—not a city in name. Ferry-accessed from Horseshoe Bay via Langdale, it mixes a village waterfront, shíshálh Nation presence, and coastal forest neighbourhoods. About 10,000 people live in Sechelt.
